verdict.rationale: Datalab offers an Enterprise on-prem/air-gapped deployment (Helm chart, run on your own infrastructure) that lets customers keep data entirely within their own infrastructure, which functionally addresses residency concerns, and Team plan includes BAA/DPA. However there is no documented cloud region-selection feature (e.g., choosing EU vs US hosted region) for the standard SaaS offering. Missing for 10: explicit multi-region cloud storage selection, documented data-residency guarantees for non-Enterprise tiers, independent confirmation of on-prem deployment working in practice.
